thread.title: Apple warning shakes European shares as chipmakers tumble By Reuters

author: Reuters
title: Apple warning shakes European shares as chipmakers tumble By Reuters
text:
© Reuters. Apple warning shakes European shares as chipmakers tumble (For a live blog on European stocks, type LIVE/ in an Eikon news window)
LONDON, Jan 3 (Reuters) - Apple's first revenue warning in nearly 12 years sent European shares sliding on Thursday with the tech sector particularly badly bruised as chipmakers which supply to the iPhone maker fell sharply.
The pan-European STOXX 600 .STOXX fell 0.7 percent as Europe joined a selloff in Asia with the Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) warning compounding fears of slowing global growth.
Apple's Frankfurt-listed shares AAPL.F fell 8.9 percent after the tech giant cut its revenue forecast, blaming weaker iPhone sales in China, whose economy has been hit by an ongoing trade war with the U.S.
Chipmakers who supply parts to Apple were the worst-hit. Shares in AMS AMS.S , which provides the facial recognition sensors used in the latest iPhones, fell 19.4 percent to the bottom of the STOXX.
Dialog Semiconductor DLGS.DE tumbled 7.8 percent, while Infineon IFXGn.DE , ASML ASML.AS , ASM International ASMI.AS , Logitech LOGN.S , and STMicroelectronics STM.MI fell 3.4 to 5.9 percent.
The tech sector .SX8P was the worst-performing, down 2.4 percent while only telecoms stayed in the black.
Luxury goods shares, which are also highly sensitive to signs of slowing demand in China, joined the selloff.
LVMH LVMH.PA , Kering PRTP.PA , Burberry BRBY.L , and Swatch UHR.S were down 2.7 to 3.8 percent, among the biggest fallers.
Among rare gainers, Next NXT.L shares topped the STOXX with a 5.9 percent gain after the clothing retailer reported a rise in sales in the run-up to Christmas in line with its own expectations. Marks & Spencer MKS.L also gained 3.3 percent.
